signal: Alianza closed its acquisition of Metaswitch from Microsoft, giving it 1,000+ service-provider customers including 19 of the top 20 global operators

email.body1:
Patrick, saw Alianza closed the Metaswitch acquisition, putting 1,000-plus service providers and 19 of the top 20 global operators in reach.

That much expanded base opens more accounts worth reaching than a senior director can personally cover, and good ones go quiet while the team works the obvious logos. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Patrick, quick follow-up for Alianza.

Absorbing the Metaswitch base means far more named accounts per rep, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number across it. The gap shows up late, then the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Patrick, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to peer telecom-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Patrick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage across the new base without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-acquisition integration is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a telecom-software motion? I will tailor it to Alianza either way.
